title: Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation

layout.note: One large rounded grey container with a title tab over its top edge. Inside, three zones are divided by black dashed vertical lines: Detection at the left (four stacked task boxes), a green central panel with the photo, the caption and a Manipulation sub-panel, and Grounding at the right (two stacked output boxes). Fat blue arrows run from the centre to each detection box and orange curves from the edited crop and phrase to the grounding boxes.

lesson: Define a new task with one annotated example: put the input record in the middle, send the questions (detection) to one side and the answers to be located (grounding) to the other, and give each side one colour that also colours the title words, headings, boxes and arrows.
